info.name: Support Copilot
info.description: Requests for the current Support Copilot API. Start the backend with `uv run support-copilot` from backend/. Set base_url to match API_HOST/API_PORT. Health requires no external services. Chat requires published knowledge, matching embedding settings, database access and a configured generation provider. Chat needs no authentication. The other endpoints need DEMO_AUTH=true and an X-Demo-User header (demo_user variable).

request.description: Check that the API is running. Expected response: 200 with {"status": "ok"}. This does not check the database or LLM.

exec: pm.test('Service is healthy', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.eql({ status: 'ok' }); });

request.description: Send the required question field. The optional category defaults to null. A grounded response may incur provider charges. Expected response: 200 with answer, status and sources.

exec: pm.test('Response contains an answer string', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().answer).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Send a question with the optional category string. The category scopes the publication search. A grounded response may incur provider charges. Expected response: 200 with answer, status and sources.

exec: pm.test('Response contains an answer string', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().answer).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Signed-in user: name, email, company, role. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.
Active agent names, sorted. Set demo_user to alex; a customer gets 403. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.
Profile with notification preferences. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Replace the profile. Set demo_user to customer; the body shows the full shape. Unknown timezone returns 422. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.
Active members of the caller's account. An agent gets 403. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.
Active knowledge articles, newest first. updated is ISO 8601. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Full-text search matching any word, best first, at most 50. topic is optional; a blank q lists articles. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

One article with markdown content and sourceUrl. Set article_id to an id from the list; unknown ids return 404. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Customers see their account's tickets (403 without an active membership); agents see all. Newest updated first. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Customer only (agents 403; members without can_open_cases, e.g. jordan, 403). consent must be true. Unknown category 422; unknown source ids keep the title and drop the id. Copy the returned id into the ticket_id variable. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

One ticket with comments and sources. Ids are SC-<number>; malformed ids and tickets in another account return 404. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Agent only. Succeeds only when unassigned and Submitted, In progress or Waiting for customer (else 409). Sets the assignee and In progress. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Agents may send a status; the first agent reply on an unassigned ticket assigns it. Customers (reporter only) must not send status; a reply on Waiting for customer or Resolved reopens to In progress. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.

Send at least one of status, assignee (agent display name; null or "" unassigns), severity. Customers (reporter only) may only send status Resolved, or Submitted to reopen a resolved case. Needs DEMO_AUTH=true on a loopback API_HOST and `sql/demo_identities.sql` applied; set the demo_user collection variable.
